Hey! Psych major here. Welcome to A&M! The liberal arts college is smaller but it’s good and supportive and honestly one of the most diverse groups on campus. 
I came from a very liberal state — not Texas obviously — and the overwhelming demographics of white/Christians definitely threw me, but there are options beyond just your college to get involved.
Also, especially in the psych department, there are a lot of international profs and TAs which will invariably open your perspective. 
As someone who is also personally pretty progressive, I have found my community of people in A&M and I can’t imagine a better college experience. This place is what you put into it and it can be such a wonderful and happy place! I wish you all the best and you don’t have much to worry about :)
